name: replace_frames
summary: Replace frames in place with another frame prefab, or finish unfinished frames, without ever opening a cell; pieces by id or a room's frames. As replace_walls. Dry run by default; confirm to swap.

help.text: Without to, each frame is rebuilt as its own prefab at its final state, which finishes it (finished frames are already_at_target). The swap, dry run, job, materials, refund and checks are replace_walls'. Only plain frames are taken or built (rocket towers are special_piece). Frames are never pressure-stressed.
help.keys: job_id, status, ready, problems [], pieces [], by_prefab [], kept_pieces [], materials [], swapped [], not_swapped [], preflight_summary, final_check, error.

scope.summary: Which frames a room names, and the footprint.
scope.text: room_id: every frame in a cell next to one of the room's cells, and frames inside the room that let gravity pass. The new frame must take the same cells at the old position and turn (footprint_mismatch otherwise). A frame blocking air or gravity must be replaced by one that blocks them too (would_open).

sealing.summary: Finishing a frame closes its cell.
sealing.text: A frame that would newly block air or gravity (seals) closes its cell, so the run is cell_occupied when anything else is in that cell: another structure, a pipe, cable, chute or device inside, a player, creature or loose item. Walls on its faces are fine and must still be there after (face_structures_changed otherwise). As when the game's last sheet is welded, the cell leaves its room and its gas is divided among its open neighbours; the room check allows for that.

reference_ids.description: The frames to replace; or give room_id.

room_id.description: A room id (rooms): every frame around that room.

to.description: The new frame prefab; default each frame's own, which finishes it.

from_prefabs.description: Only pieces of these prefabs; the others are kept as not_selected.

from_id.description: The thing whose slots pay and take the refund; default the player (see swaps/materials).

skip_unmatched.description: Leave pieces that cannot be swapped (footprint_mismatch, invalid_target) as they are instead of refusing. Default false.

refund.description: Give back what the old pieces return beyond what the new ones cost. Default true; false is refund_to none.

job_id.description: Poll a confirmed run; give nothing else.
